title: Reimagining healthcare from the ground up: Meet the 15 trailblazing startups of I‑HEAL @ ISB 3.0 cohort
summary: I‑HEAL @ ISB's third cohort showcased 15 early-stage healthtech startups addressing last-mile access and affordability in India. The accelerator guided ventures through product refinement, regulatory advisory, clinical validation and market access, culminating in a Demo Day on March 24, 2025. content:
I‑HEAL @ ISB — Thursday April 17, 2025 — 5 min Read

Despite rapid strides in India's healthcare ecosystem, access and affordability remain persistent challenges, especially at the last mile. Whether reaching under-served geographies or supporting vulnerable communities such as women, children and the elderly, systemic gaps continue to plague delivery models. I‑HEAL @ ISB, the flagship healthcare accelerator by DLabs under ISB I‑Venture, was created to address these realities by backing impact-led startups focused on scalable solutions.

Now in its third edition, I‑HEAL @ ISB focuses on bridging access and affordability gaps by selecting early-stage ventures with tested prototypes and guiding them through a rigorous acceleration journey. The program covers product refinement, regulatory advisory, mentorship, market access, clinical validation and funding opportunities. The structured approach starts with a nationwide Call for Applications, followed by Screening and Onboarding, an Acceleration Phase and a Demo Day. At this year's Demo Day on March 24, 2025, 15 startups showcased their visions, growth and traction.

1) Neurorehabilitation solution
Addressing the high cost and clinic-limited nature of neurorehabilitation for stroke patients, one startup offers home-based products ReBa (balance training) and REHA (upper limb therapy). The devices enable hospitals to extend recovery exercises beyond clinical settings, improving patient adherence and recovery timelines.

2) Enterprise follow-up and adherence platform
An enterprise SaaS platform powered by specialised language models tackles missed follow-ups and poor adherence. The system integrates with hospital information systems to deliver personalised care journeys through voice and chat automation, reducing missed appointments and improving operational efficiency.

3) Eturnal Home patient repositioning
To prevent pressure injuries in bedridden patients, Eturnal Home provides an automatic patient repositioning system with customisable positions, fall-lock safety and remote monitoring, reducing caregiver burden particularly in high patient-to-nurse ratio settings.

4) Non-invasive sickle cell point-of-care test
A portable, non-invasive device using an LED probe and sensor enables safe, bloodless screening for Sickle Cell Disease in remote tribal populations. The solution is suited for mass screening and follows a B2B and B2G model targeting primary health centres, NGOs, ambulances, labs and schools.

5) Non-hormonal reproductive health solution
A women-focused startup developed FertiGen, a non-hormonal vaginal insert for treating infertility that claims higher efficacy than traditional procedures. Built on nanomaterials developed in IIT Bombay labs, the approach aims to avoid hormone-related side effects and scale across diverse economic groups.

6) AR-enabled 3D printed bone sets for education
To address shortages in anatomy teaching aids, an Augmented Reality based 3D printed bone set (ABA system) pairs high-resolution 3D hardware with software features such as VoIP calling, AR/VR visualisation and quiz modes to enhance medical education.

7) ReMed+ smart pillbox
ReMed+ is India's first AI-powered smart pillbox system that simplifies medication management for chronic patients. The patented device uses audio-visual reminders and behavioural techniques to track adherence and generate reports that improve compliance.

8) Glaucoma detection and adherence
A VR-based Intelligent Vision Analyser (iVA) is already used by over 250 ophthalmologists to detect glaucoma. Complementary Droptor IoT sensors monitor eye drop adherence to prevent further vision deterioration.

9) AI-powered CRM for hospitals
A solution for small and mid-sized hospitals fixes disconnected systems and fragmented data with an AI CRM that monitors patient acquisition channels, analyses call centre conversations, automates multi-platform messaging and identifies conversion opportunities.

10) Neuro-compute platform for complex conditions
A patented neuro-compute platform builds an integrated suite for neurological, musculoskeletal and metabolic conditions, including MiMo for cognition and biomechanics assessment and ReLive, an AI engine for metabolic management.

11) Fully autonomous AI diabetes care
Targeting India's 100 million people with diabetes, one startup offers a fully AI-driven program that delivers personalised care at a fraction of traditional costs. The autonomous system gives real-time daily guidance and supports vernacular languages for wider reach.

12) End-to-end critical care and ambulance network
To address emergency care shortages, this venture builds a critical care service network with properly equipped ambulances, trained emergency personnel, essential crash carts and technologies that connect patients to ER doctors, reducing delays in lifesaving care.

13) Full-stack digital pathology
A digital pathology solution integrates workflow software with AI algorithms to help the small pool of pathologists deliver faster and more precise diagnostic reports, relieving a bottleneck in cancer diagnosis.

14) MoveAxon wearable for musculoskeletal disorders
MoveAxon is an indigenous smart wearable using edge computing and analytics to serve India's population with musculoskeletal disorders. It provides pre/post-operative insights, supports treatment decisions, monitors performance and analyses movement to reduce injury risk.

15) Mu-Sure rapid single-use tests
Mu-Sure offers a single-use, zero-electronics test kit that delivers lab-quality TSH and HbA1c results in under 20 minutes. The affordable, no-device approach enables on-the-spot testing in resource-limited settings and avoids upfront device investments.

Startups in the cohort described the program as transformative, praising tailored go-to-market workshops, expert mentorship and peer learning. They highlighted hands-on support for refining strategy, product and pitch, and valued access to a collaborative ecosystem.

These 15 startups represent a cross-section of technology-enabled solutions aimed at making healthcare more accessible and affordable in India. With I‑HEAL @ ISB's support, these ventures are moving from promising prototypes to market-ready innovations that could impact millions across the country.

It’s in response to this reality thatI‑HEAL @ ISB, the flagship healthcare accelerator by DLabs under ISB I‑Venture, was born.

Now in its third edition, the I‑HEAL @ ISB accelerator focuses on bridging these gaps by backing startups that bring innovative, impact-led healthcare solutions to the forefront. From digital health platforms to geriatric care services, the cohort includes early-stage ventures with tested prototypes that are guided through a rigorous acceleration journey—including product refinement, regulatory advisory, mentorship, market access, clinical validation, and funding opportunities.

The program follows a structured approach—beginning with a nationwide Call for Applications, followed by a Screening and Onboarding phase, an Acceleration Phase, and culminating in a Demo Day. At this year’s Demo Day, held on March 24, 2025, 15 startups took center stage to showcase their vision, growth, and traction.

Addressing the challenge of expensive and clinic-limited neurorehabilitation for stroke patients through innovative home-based solutions. Its products, ReBa (for balance training) and REHA (for upper limb therapy), enable hospitals to extend critical recovery exercises beyond clinical settings, improving patient adherence and recovery times.

Tackling the problem of missed follow-ups and poor adherence to care instructions through its enterprise SaaS platform powered by Specialised Language Models. The system integrates with hospital information systems to deliver personalised care journeys through voice and chat automation, reducing missed appointments while optimising operational efficiency for healthcare providers.

The solution features customisable positions, fall-lock safety features, and remote monitoring capabilities, significantly reducing caregiver burden in settings with high patient-to-nurse ratios.

Addressing Sickle Cell Disease diagnosis challenges in remote tribal populations through a groundbreaking non-invasive, point-of-care device requiring no blood collection. Its portable LED probe and sensor technology makes testing safe and environmentally friendly—ideal for mass screening programs. The B2B and B2G model targets primary health centers, NGOs, ambulance services, laboratories, and schools in underserved tribal areas.

Revolutionising women's reproductive healthcare with non-hormonal solutions that avoid the side effects of traditional hormone therapies. Its first product, FertiGen, is a non-hormonal vaginal insert for treating infertility that's 7X more efficient than Intrauterine Insemination procedures. Developed in IIT Bombay's labs, the technology offers superior scalability through innovative nanomaterials, serving women across diverse economic backgrounds.

Solving the critical shortage of bone sets for medical education through its Augmented Reality-based 3D printed bone sets (ABA system). Its comprehensive solution includes high-resolution 3D printed hardware enhanced with software features like VoIP calling, AR/VR visualisation, and quiz modes.

Simplifying medication management for patients with chronic conditions through ReMed+, India's first AI-powered smart pillbox system. The patented technology uses audio-visual reminders and behavioral techniques to track adherence and generate reports, significantly improving compliance rates.

Addressing the silent threat of glaucoma with its Intelligent Vision Analyser (iVA), a VR-based diagnostic tool already used by over 250 ophthalmologists nationwide. A complementary product, Droptor, is an IoT sensor tracking eye drop adherence to prevent further vision deterioration.

Helping small and mid-sized hospitals overcome disconnected systems and fragmented data through an AI-powered CRM. Its solution monitors patient acquisition channels, analyses call center conversations, automates multi-platform messaging, and identifies conversion opportunities.

Building a comprehensive solution for neurological, musculoskeletal, and metabolic conditions through its patented neuro-compute platform. Its integrated system includes MiMo for assessing cognition and biomechanics, and ReLive, an AI engine for metabolic condition management.

Transforming diabetes management for India's 100 million patients with the country's first fully AI-driven program delivering personalised care at just 10% of traditional costs. The autonomous system provides real-time daily guidance without human intervention, enhanced with vernacular language options.

Addressing India's emergency care crisis where 90% of ambulances lack lifesaving technology and 10,800 daily deaths occur due to delayed care. Its end-to-end critical care service network includes properly equipped ambulances, skilled emergency personnel, essential crash carts, and technologies connecting patients to ER doctors.

Solving the cancer diagnosis bottleneck where just 500 pathologists serve approximately 2 million new cancer patients annually. The full-stack digital pathology solution integrates workflow software with AI algorithms, helping pathologists deliver faster, more precise diagnostic reports.

Addressing the needs of 150 million Indians with musculoskeletal disorders through MoveAxon, India's first indigenous smart wearable using edge computing and analytics. The technology provides pre/post-operative insights, aids treatment decisions, monitors performance, and analyses movement patterns to reduce injury risks.

Tackling the severe underutilisation of diagnostic testing in India with Mu-Sure, a single-use, zero-electronics test kit delivering lab-quality results for TSH and HbA1c in under 20 minutes. The affordable solution requires no upfront device investment, enabling on-the-spot testing in resource-limited settings.

“Startups in the cohort called the program transformative, citing its tailored GTM workshops, expert mentorship, and high-impact peer learning. They valued the hands-on support in refining strategy, product, and pitch, along with access to a thriving, collaborative ecosystem.”

These 15 startups represent the future of accessible, affordable healthcare in India—each addressing critical gaps through technology-enabled solutions. Through I-HEAL @ ISB's support, they're transforming from promising prototypes to market-ready innovations poised to impact millions of lives across the country.
